_help: Sample projects an interviewer can pick. difficulty: easy, medium, hard, extra-hard or uncategorized. ref: the commit every candidate gets. services: databases to start with it (postgres, mongodb). env: settings given to the editor. setup: a shell command run once in the project folder at session start (no single quotes).

projects.name: Full Stack FastAPI Template
projects.description: A web application template: a FastAPI backend with a React front end.
projects.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && (cd frontend && bun run build) && (cd backend && uv sync --frozen && uv run bash scripts/prestart.sh)

projects.name: Spring PetClinic REST
projects.description: The PetClinic sample as a REST API without a user interface. Uses an in-memory database.

projects.name: Node Express Boilerplate
projects.description: A starting point for a REST API in Express, with sign-in, users and tests.
